newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EC imposes anti-dumping duty on Malaysian yarn.
newsitem.headline: EC imposes anti-dumping duty on Malaysian yarn.

text.p: The European Commission has imposed anti-dumping duties on imports of polyester textured yarn from Malaysia, according to its Official Journal.
Following a complaint from the International Committee of Rayon and Synthetic Fibres, an investigation was held between January 1994 to March 1995 into exports of polyester yarn from Malaysia.
Seven European companies cooperated with the investigation, but only one of 15 producers in Malaysia assisted, the Journal said.

The Journal said Malaysian exporters were dumping, and duties of 16.4 percent have been applied to exports from a Kuala Lumpur factory owned by Taiwan's Hualon Corporation and 32.5 percent from all other Malaysian producers.
Hualon was the only company which cooperated with the investigation, the Journal said.
Polyester textured yarn is used extensively in the garment industry especially as a weave in cotton-rich clothing.
